battle.light: One adult human woman, readable fitted thin armor, both hands and feet visible.
battle.heavy: Same anchor face/hair/body; broad stacked plates visibly enlarge the armor outline.
battle.mobility: Same anchor face/hair/body; swept panels and compact thrusters give an open outline.
battle.overdrive: Each closed form used directly as reference; camera, body pose and scale retained. Hinged seams open around the original plates. No held weapon, new character or new helmet.

casual.observed: Lavender cropped knit top and cream wrap skirt at a bay window. An open illustrated field guide lies across her lap; one hand turns the page while the other supports her cheek. Same purple eyes and twin tails; gaze is softer than the planned wistful look. Crop includes knees rather than chest-up; retained as framing variation.

Ochre off-shoulder fieldwear with olive short skirt, forest trail, map-sketchbook, bag and hanging magnifier. Both hands hold the unfolded map; low viewpoint and above-knee crop match. Trail study appears through the map rather than magnifier-to-track contact; pose and small activity detail retained.

Navy star-badge event costume beside bulb-lit dressing mirror; one hand adjusts cap and the other hangs naturally. Full body, two feet and two distinct arms. Mirror reflects lights without duplicating the woman; side cutouts and cropped shirt remain visible.

diversity.observed: Office-party decoration, luggage packing, cabana drink, field-guide reading, trail-map research and costume preparation have distinct activities and clothing silhouettes. Existing breakfast, record-store, pool-stair, pond drink, evening bar, plant-watering and swim-cap images were compared visually. The new three-image sets do not reuse one fixed stance or crop sequence.
